```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.2, dpi = 300
)

library(ggplot2)
has_ft <- requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_ft) {
  flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
    font.family = "Calibri", font.size = 9,
    padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4
  )
}

make_tab <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  if (has_ft) {
    ft <- flextable::flextable(df)
    ft <- flextable::theme_booktabs(ft)
    ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
    ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
      ft, width = 1, layout = "autofit",
      opts_word = list(split = FALSE, repeat_headers = TRUE)
    )
    if (!is.null(caption)) ft <- flextable::set_caption(ft, caption = caption)
    return(ft)
  }
  knitr::kable(df, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)
}

life    <- params$life_dir
deriv   <- file.path(life, "derivatives")
ms_dir  <- file.path(deriv, "matching_and_summaries")
out_dir <- file.path(ms_dir, "summary_sample_variables_and_dates")
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_tab <- function(df, name) {
  write.csv(df, file.path(out_dir, name), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}

save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 6.5, h = 4.2) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, name), plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", x, fixed = TRUE)))
  v[!is.finite(v)] <- NA_real_
  v
}

parse_any_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(x))
  is_num <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^[0-9]{5}(\\.[0-9]+)?$", x)
  if (any(is_num)) {
    out[is_num] <- as.Date(floor(as.numeric(x[is_num])), origin = "1899-12-30")
  }
  rem <- which(!is.na(x) & is.na(out))
  for (fmt in c("%Y-%m-%d", "%d.%m.%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d/%m/%Y")) {
    if (!length(rem)) break
    d <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(substr(x[rem], 1, 10), format = fmt))
    ok <- !is.na(d)
    if (any(ok)) {
      out[rem[ok]] <- d[ok]
      rem <- rem[!ok]
    }
  }
  out
}

# Load post-exclusion dataset (before pipeline-specific exclusions)
data_path <- file.path(deriv, "data_after_exclusion.csv")
if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Cannot find data_after_exclusion.csv at: ", data_path)
raw_df <- read.csv(data_path, colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# New covariates must be added by 06b; do not silently revert to older fields.
required_new <- c("diabetes_final", "lvedv_lvesv", "height")
missing_new <- setdiff(required_new, names(raw_df))
if (length(missing_new)) {
  stop("Missing post-06b control columns: ", paste(missing_new, collapse = ", "),
       ". Run 06b_LIFE_match_add_controls_after_exclusion.R before knitting.")
}

n_total_rows <- nrow(raw_df)
df <- raw_df[!duplicated(raw_df$life_id), , drop = FALSE]
N <- nrow(df)

# Clean & derive analysis variables safely
df$GAD7_num   <- to_num(df$GAD7)
df$age_num    <- to_num(df$age_eeg)
df$IDS_num    <- ifelse(to_num(df$all_IDS) == 1, to_num(df$IDS), NA_real_)
df$bmi_num    <- to_num(df$bmi)
df$sbp_num    <- to_num(df$sbp)
df$dbp_num    <- to_num(df$dbp)
df$hr_num     <- to_num(df$HR_bpm)
df$rmssd_num  <- to_num(df$RMSSD_ms)
df$sv_num     <- to_num(df$lvedv_lvesv)  # biplane Simpson LVEDV - LVESV, mL
# Height is descriptive only, not entered into the preregistered control PCA.
df$height_num <- to_num(df$height)
df$height_num[df$height_num %in% c(996, 998, 999)] <- NA_real_
df$ecg_hr_num <- to_num(df$ecg_hr)
df$extra_num  <- to_num(df$extrasystolic_N)
df$vig_bc_num <- to_num(df$vigall_b) + to_num(df$vigall_c)

# Sex harmonization (LIFE uses 1=male, 2=female or M/F strings)
g_raw <- toupper(trimws(as.character(df$gender)))
df$sex_clean <- ifelse(g_raw %in% c("2", "F", "FEMALE", "W", "WEIBLICH"), "Female",
                ifelse(g_raw %in% c("1", "M", "MALE", "MAENNLICH", "MÄNNLICH"), "Male", g_raw))
df$is_female <- ifelse(df$sex_clean == "Female", 1, ifelse(df$sex_clean == "Male", 0, NA_real_))

# Diabetes: ADA 2021-derived ADA_DS as joined by 06b; 1=diabetes, 0=absent.
# Missing values remain missing. Never substitute an older questionnaire field.
diab_raw <- trimws(as.character(df$diabetes_final))
diab_raw[is.na(diab_raw) | !nzchar(diab_raw)] <- NA_character_
bad_diabetes <- unique(diab_raw[!is.na(diab_raw) & !(diab_raw %in% c("0", "1"))])
if (length(bad_diabetes)) {
  stop("Unexpected diabetes_final codes (expected only 0, 1, or missing): ",
       paste(bad_diabetes, collapse = ", "))
}
df$diab_bin <- ifelse(diab_raw == "1", 1,
               ifelse(diab_raw == "0", 0, NA_real_))

# Anxiety strata
df$anx_stratum <- ifelse(!is.na(df$GAD7_num) & df$GAD7_num <= 4, "Low (0-4)",
                  ifelse(!is.na(df$GAD7_num) & df$GAD7_num >= 5 & df$GAD7_num <= 9, "Mild/Middle (5-9)",
                  ifelse(!is.na(df$GAD7_num) & df$GAD7_num >= 10, "High (10-21)", "Missing")))
df$anx_stratum <- factor(df$anx_stratum, levels = c("Low (0-4)", "Mild/Middle (5-9)", "High (10-21)"))

# Parse dates
date_cols <- c("date_eeg", "date_gad7", "date_ids", "date_bp", "date_bmi",
               "date_ecg", "date_echo", "date_echo_2", "date_medications", "date_med_anamnese")
date_cols <- intersect(date_cols, names(df))
for (dc in date_cols) {
  df[[paste0(dc, "_dt")]] <- parse_any_date(df[[dc]])
}

df$gap_eeg_gad7_signed <- as.numeric(df$date_eeg_dt - df$date_gad7_dt)
df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs    <- abs(df$gap_eeg_gad7_signed)
df$under_30d           <- !is.na(df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs) & df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs < 30
```

## 1. Sample Scope & Variable Architecture

This document characterizes **`data_after_exclusion.csv`** (`N =` `r N` unique participants; `r n_total_rows` rows), representing the clean population sample **after all preregistered participant-level exclusions** (invalid GAD-7, CNS-active medications, neurological/cardiac conditions, alcohol on EEG day, excessive extrasystoles, and VIGALL drowsiness >15 min) and **before pipeline-specific EEG rejections**. The additional control variables were joined **after common exclusions by script 06b**, using only confirmed one-to-one participant matches. The control-analysis stroke volume is `lvedv_lvesv` (biplane modified Simpson difference, in mL); diabetes is `diabetes_final` (ADA 2021 definition: 0 = no, 1 = yes). Height is displayed descriptively but is not an additional preregistered PCA covariate. As in the original summary, one row per `life_id` is used for descriptive statistics; where IDs have repeated rows, the first is retained for these summaries.

```{r domain-inventory}
dom_df <- data.frame(
  Domain = c(
    "Identifiers & Visit Metadata",
    "Primary Predictor: Anxiety (GAD-7)",
    "Demographics (Preregistered Controls & Descriptives)",
    "Simultaneous 20-min Resting ECG (Controls)",
    "Psychometric Control: Depression (IDS-SR)",
    "Cardiometabolic & Exam Controls",
    "Echocardiography Control",
    "12-Lead Clinical ECG & Anamnesis",
    "Vigilance & Extrasystole Screening"
  ),
  Columns_in_Dataset = c(
    "life_id, Column2, sic, group, date_eeg, group2/date_eeg2, group3",
    "GAD7_GAD7_1..7, all_GAD7, GAD7, gad7_group, date_gad7",
    "age_eeg, gender (birthdate); height (anthropometry, descriptive only)",
    "HR_bpm, RMSSD_ms (computed from 20-min EEG/ECG R-peaks)",
    "IDS_I01..I30, IDS_n_items, all_IDS, IDS, date_ids",
    "bmi (date_bmi), sbp, dbp (date_bp), diabetes_final (ADA_DS; 0/1)",
    "lvedv_lvesv = echo_lvedv_mod_bp - echo_lvesv_mod_bp; date_echo",
    "date_ecg, ecg_hr, ecg_pwave/pq/qrs/qt, hypertension, cardio/med anamnesis flags",
    "vigall_all_segments, vigall_b, vigall_c, drowsy_15min, ecg_n/v/s_beats, extrasystolic_*"
  ),
  Role_in_Registered_Report = c(
    "Participant linking & temporal gap calculation",
    "Continuous predictor (H1a,c: 0-21) & Group contrast (H1b,d: 0-4 vs 10-21)",
    "Age/sex controls (PCA & mediation); height only for sample description",
    "Control covariates (HR & HRV RMSSD)",
    "Control covariate (requires complete 28-slot IDS score: all_IDS == 1)",
    "Control covariates (BMI, systolic/diastolic BP, diabetes presence)",
    "Control covariate (modified Simpson biplane stroke volume, mL)",
    "Sample description & QC (12-lead raw waveforms used separately in CFA control)",
    "Already filtered at common exclusion stage (drowsy <= 15m, extrasystoles <= 4 SD)"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
save_tab(dom_df, "01_dataset_variable_architecture.csv")
make_tab(dom_df, caption = "Table 1. Overview of variable domains in data_after_exclusion.csv (EEG alpha power is pipeline-specific and joined later).")
```

## 2. Primary Predictor: Trait Anxiety (GAD-7) & Group Sizes

Per Section 2.4.6.3 of the preregistration, we compare the GAD-7 distribution in our post-exclusion EEG sample against the broader LIFE-Adult cohort reported by Hinz et al. (2023; $M = 3.28, SD = 3.16$, ~10% scoring $\ge 10$).

```{r gad7-summary}
gad_vals <- df$GAD7_num[!is.na(df$GAD7_num)]

gad_item_cols <- paste0("GAD7_GAD7_", 1:7)
gad_mat <- as.data.frame(lapply(df[gad_item_cols], to_num))
gad_cc <- gad_mat[complete.cases(gad_mat), ]
k_items <- ncol(gad_cc)
cronbach_alpha <- if (nrow(gad_cc) > 10) {
  item_vars <- sum(apply(gad_cc, 2, var))
  tot_var   <- var(rowSums(gad_cc))
  (k_items / (k_items - 1)) * (1 - item_vars / tot_var)
} else NA_real_

gad_stats <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Valid N (complete 7-item GAD-7)",
    "Mean (SD)",
    "Median (IQR; Q25 - Q75)",
    "Observed Range (Min - Max)",
    "Internal Consistency (Cronbach's alpha)",
    "Low Anxiety Group: GAD-7 0-4 (H1b/d Control)",
    "Mild / Middle Range: GAD-7 5-9 (Continuous H1a/c only)",
    "High Anxiety Group: GAD-7 10-21 (H1b/d Clinical Cutoff)",
    "  -> Moderate (GAD-7 10-14)",
    "  -> Severe (GAD-7 15-21)"
  ),
  Sample_Value = c(
    sprintf("%d / %d (%.1f%%)", length(gad_vals), N, 100 * length(gad_vals) / N),
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)  [LIFE ref: 3.28 (3.16)]", mean(gad_vals), sd(gad_vals)),
    sprintf("%.1f (%.1f - %.1f)", median(gad_vals), quantile(gad_vals, 0.25), quantile(gad_vals, 0.75)),
    sprintf("%.0f - %.0f", min(gad_vals), max(gad_vals)),
    sprintf("%.3f", cronbach_alpha),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(gad_vals <= 4), 100 * mean(gad_vals <= 4)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(gad_vals >= 5 & gad_vals <= 9), 100 * mean(gad_vals >= 5 & gad_vals <= 9)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)  [Prereg min required: N >= 25]", sum(gad_vals >= 10), 100 * mean(gad_vals >= 10)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(gad_vals >= 10 & gad_vals <= 14), 100 * mean(gad_vals >= 10 & gad_vals <= 14)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(gad_vals >= 15), 100 * mean(gad_vals >= 15))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
save_tab(gad_stats, "02_gad7_distribution_and_groups.csv")
make_tab(gad_stats, caption = "Table 2. GAD-7 summary statistics and preregistered anxiety group sizes.")
```

```{r gad7-plot, fig.height=3.6}
df_gad <- df[!is.na(df$GAD7_num), ]
p_gad <- ggplot(df_gad, aes(x = GAD7_num, fill = anx_stratum)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.78, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(4.5, 9.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low (0-4)" = "#4E79A7", "Mild/Middle (5-9)" = "#A0CBE8", "High (10-21)" = "#E15759")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of GAD-7 Scores in the Post-Exclusion Sample",
    subtitle = sprintf("N = %d | Mean = %.2f, SD = %.2f, Median = %.0f (dashed lines mark 0-4 and 10-21 cutoffs)",
                       nrow(df_gad), mean(df_gad$GAD7_num), sd(df_gad$GAD7_num), median(df_gad$GAD7_num)),
    x = "GAD-7 Total Score", y = "Number of Participants", fill = "Anxiety Stratum"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

save_fig(p_gad, "fig01_gad7_distribution.png", w = 6.5, h = 3.6)
print(p_gad)
```

## 3. Descriptive Summary of Key & Preregistered Control Variables

Section 2.4.5.2 registers **10 participant-level covariates**, plus **pipeline-specific EEG alpha power** (11 variables in the final control PCA) and the `GAD-7 * EEG-GAD7 gap` interaction. Complete-case counts below include the 10 participant-level controls and the availability of the GAD-7/EEG date gap; **alpha power is not yet included**. Height is not a preregistered control.

```{r continuous-descriptives}
cont_spec <- list(
  list(col = "GAD7_num",   label = "GAD-7 Anxiety Score (0-21)"),
  list(col = "age_num",    label = "Age at EEG (years)"),
  list(col = "hr_num",     label = "Resting Heart Rate - 20m EEG/ECG (bpm)"),
  list(col = "rmssd_num",  label = "Heart Rate Variability - RMSSD (ms)"),
  list(col = "IDS_num",    label = "Depression Score - IDS-SR Complete (0-84)"),
  list(col = "bmi_num",    label = "Body Mass Index - BMI (kg/m2)"),
  list(col = "height_num", label = "Height - Anthropometry (cm; descriptive only)"),
  list(col = "sbp_num",    label = "Systolic Blood Pressure - SBP (mmHg)"),
  list(col = "dbp_num",    label = "Diastolic Blood Pressure - DBP (mmHg)"),
  list(col = "sv_num",     label = "Stroke Volume - Biplane LVEDV minus LVESV (mL)"),
  list(col = "ecg_hr_num", label = "Clinical 12-Lead ECG Heart Rate (bpm)"),
  list(col = "extra_num",  label = "Extrasystolic Beats in 20m Recording (count)"),
  list(col = "vig_bc_num", label = "VIGALL Drowsy B+C Segments (sec, <=900)")
)

desc_rows <- lapply(cont_spec, function(item) {
  v <- df[[item$col]]
  v_ok <- v[!is.na(v)]
  n_ok <- length(v_ok)
  n_miss <- N - n_ok
  if (n_ok == 0) {
    return(data.frame(Variable = item$label, Valid_N = "0", Missing = sprintf("%d (100%%)", N),
                      Mean_SD = "-", Median_IQR = "-", Min_Max = "-", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  data.frame(
    Variable = item$label,
    Valid_N = as.character(n_ok),
    Missing = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_miss, 100 * n_miss / N),
    Mean_SD = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(v_ok), sd(v_ok)),
    Median_IQR = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f - %.2f)", median(v_ok), quantile(v_ok, 0.25), quantile(v_ok, 0.75)),
    Min_Max = sprintf("%.1f - %.1f", min(v_ok), max(v_ok)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
desc_df <- do.call(rbind, desc_rows)
save_tab(desc_df, "03_continuous_variables_summary.csv")
make_tab(desc_df, caption = "Table 3. Summary statistics and missingness for continuous study variables.")
```

```{r categorical-descriptives}
htn_num   <- ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$hypertension)) == "1", 1,
             ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$hypertension)) == "0", 0, NA_real_))
med_num   <- ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$takes_medication)) == "1", 1,
             ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$takes_medication)) == "0", 0, NA_real_))
depr_self <- ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$depression)) == "1", 1,
             ifelse(trimws(as.character(df$depression)) == "0", 0, NA_real_))

ctrl_vars_10 <- c("age_num", "is_female", "hr_num", "rmssd_num", "IDS_num",
                  "diab_bin", "bmi_num", "sbp_num", "dbp_num", "sv_num")
cc_no_sv  <- complete.cases(df[, setdiff(ctrl_vars_10, "sv_num")]) & !is.na(df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs)
cc_all_11 <- complete.cases(df[, ctrl_vars_10]) & !is.na(df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs)

cat_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(
    "Sex: Female (Preregistered Control)",
    "Diabetes: Yes (ADA_DS / diabetes_final; preregistered)",
    "Hypertension Flag: Yes (Descriptive)",
    "Takes Any Non-CNS Medication: Yes (Descriptive)",
    "Self-Reported Lifetime Depression History: Yes (Descriptive)",
    "Complete Cases: 9 participant controls (excluding SV) + date gap",
    "Complete Cases: All 10 participant controls (incl. biplane SV) + date gap"
  ),
  Valid_N = c(
    as.character(sum(!is.na(df$is_female))),
    as.character(sum(!is.na(df$diab_bin))),
    as.character(sum(!is.na(htn_num))),
    as.character(sum(!is.na(med_num))),
    as.character(sum(!is.na(depr_self))),
    as.character(N),
    as.character(N)
  ),
  Count_Pct = c(
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%% Female | %d Male)", sum(df$is_female == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            100 * mean(df$is_female == 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(df$is_female == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(df$diab_bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(df$diab_bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(htn_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(htn_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(med_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(med_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(depr_self == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(depr_self == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%% of N = %d)", sum(cc_no_sv), 100 * mean(cc_no_sv), N),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%% of N = %d)", sum(cc_all_11), 100 * mean(cc_all_11), N)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
save_tab(cat_df, "04_categorical_and_complete_case_summary.csv")
make_tab(cat_df, caption = "Table 4. Categorical variables and complete-case availability before adding pipeline-specific alpha power. Diabetes uses ADA_DS (0 = absent, 1 = present; missing stays missing).")
```

```{r control-distributions-plot, fig.height=5.2}
dist_vars <- list(
  "Age at EEG (years)" = df$age_num,
  "Heart Rate (bpm)" = df$hr_num,
  "RMSSD HRV (ms, <=150 shown)" = ifelse(df$rmssd_num <= 150, df$rmssd_num, NA_real_),
  "IDS-SR Depression Score" = df$IDS_num,
  "BMI (kg/m2)" = df$bmi_num,
  "Systolic BP (mmHg)" = df$sbp_num,
  "Diastolic BP (mmHg)" = df$dbp_num,
  "Echo SV - Biplane (mL)" = df$sv_num
)

long_dist <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(dist_vars), function(nm) {
  v <- dist_vars[[nm]]
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Variable = nm, Value = v, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
long_dist$Variable <- factor(long_dist$Variable, levels = names(dist_vars))

p_dist <- ggplot(long_dist, aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4E79A7", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Distributions of Preregistered Continuous Control Variables",
    subtitle = "Evaluated on post-exclusion sample (RMSSD truncated at 150 ms in plot for readability)",
    x = NULL, y = "Count"

  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(p_dist, "fig02_control_variable_distributions.png", w = 6.5, h = 5.2)
print(p_dist)
```

### Additional QC: Control-Variable Availability

A compact view of **how many participants are actually usable for each preregistered participant-level control** after conservative matching. The bars are based on unique `life_id` records; no unavailable diabetes or stroke-volume values are imputed.

```{r control-coverage-plot, fig.height=4.2}
ctrl_labels <- c(
  age_num = "Age", is_female = "Sex", hr_num = "HR", rmssd_num = "RMSSD",
  IDS_num = "IDS-SR", diab_bin = "Diabetes (ADA_DS)", bmi_num = "BMI",
  sbp_num = "Systolic BP", dbp_num = "Diastolic BP", sv_num = "Biplane SV"
)
ctrl_available <- vapply(names(ctrl_labels), function(v) sum(!is.na(df[[v]])), integer(1))
coverage_df <- data.frame(
  Control = unname(ctrl_labels), Available_N = as.integer(ctrl_available),
  Missing_N = N - as.integer(ctrl_available),
  Availability_Pct = 100 * as.integer(ctrl_available) / N,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
save_tab(coverage_df, "04b_control_variable_availability.csv")

p_cov <- ggplot(coverage_df, aes(x = reorder(Control, Availability_Pct), y = Availability_Pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7", width = 0.73) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d / %d", Available_N, N)), hjust = -0.08, size = 3) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, 110)) +
  labs(title = "Availability of Preregistered Participant-Level Controls",

       x = NULL, y = "Available participants (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
save_fig(p_cov, "fig06_control_variable_availability.png", w = 6.5, h = 4.2)
print(p_cov)
```

## 4. Comparison of Low vs. High Anxiety Groups (Hypothesis 1b/1d)

Per Section 2.4.6.3, we test whether the **Low Anxiety (`GAD-7: 0-4`)** and **High Anxiety (`GAD-7: 10-21`)** groups differ on demographic, psychological, or physiological parameters (Wilcoxon rank-sum test + Cohen's $d$ for continuous variables; $\chi^2$ test for binary variables). Mild/Middle (`5-9`) is shown alongside for reference.

```{r group-comparison-table}
cohen_d <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; y <- y[!is.na(y)]
  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  s_pool <- sqrt(((length(x) - 1) * var(x) + (length(y) - 1) * var(y)) / (length(x) + length(y) - 2))
  if (s_pool == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (mean(y) - mean(x)) / s_pool
}

idx_lo  <- which(df$anx_stratum == "Low (0-4)")
idx_mid <- which(df$anx_stratum == "Mild/Middle (5-9)")
idx_hi  <- which(df$anx_stratum == "High (10-21)")

comp_vars <- list(
  list(col = "age_num",          label = "Age at EEG (years)",     type = "cont"),
  list(col = "is_female",        label = "Sex: Female (%)",        type = "bin"),
  list(col = "IDS_num",          label = "Depression (IDS-SR)",    type = "cont"),
  list(col = "hr_num",           label = "Heart Rate (bpm)",       type = "cont"),
  list(col = "rmssd_num",        label = "HRV RMSSD (ms)",         type = "cont"),
  list(col = "bmi_num",          label = "BMI (kg/m2)",            type = "cont"),
  list(col = "sbp_num",          label = "Systolic BP (mmHg)",     type = "cont"),
  list(col = "dbp_num",          label = "Diastolic BP (mmHg)",    type = "cont"),
  list(col = "sv_num",           label = "Biplane Stroke Volume (mL)", type = "cont"),
  list(col = "diab_bin",         label = "Diabetes (ADA_DS): Yes (%)", type = "bin"),
  list(col = "gap_eeg_gad7_abs", label = "|EEG - GAD-7 Gap| (days)", type = "cont")
)

comp_rows <- lapply(comp_vars, function(item) {
  v <- df[[item$col]]
  v_lo <- v[idx_lo]; v_mid <- v[idx_mid]; v_hi <- v[idx_hi]

  if (item$type == "cont") {
    pval <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(v_lo, v_hi)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    eff  <- cohen_d(v_lo, v_hi)
    data.frame(
      Variable = item$label,
      Low_0_4 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f) [n=%d]", mean(v_lo, na.rm = TRUE), sd(v_lo, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(v_lo))),
      Mid_5_9 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f) [n=%d]", mean(v_mid, na.rm = TRUE), sd(v_mid, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(v_mid))),
      High_10_21 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f) [n=%d]", mean(v_hi, na.rm = TRUE), sd(v_hi, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(v_hi))),
      Effect_Hi_vs_Lo = ifelse(is.na(eff), "-", sprintf("d = %+.2f", eff)),
      p_value = ifelse(is.na(pval), "-", ifelse(pval < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pval))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    fmt_b <- function(b) {
      b <- b[!is.na(b)]
      if (!length(b)) return("-")
      sprintf("%d / %d (%.1f%%)", sum(b == 1), length(b), 100 * mean(b == 1))
    }
    tab2 <- table(Group = c(rep("Lo", length(v_lo)), rep("Hi", length(v_hi))),
                  Val = c(v_lo, v_hi))
    pval <- if (all(dim(tab2) == c(2, 2))) tryCatch(chisq.test(tab2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_
    diff_pct <- 100 * (mean(v_hi == 1, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(v_lo == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
    data.frame(
      Variable = item$label,
      Low_0_4 = fmt_b(v_lo),
      Mid_5_9 = fmt_b(v_mid),
      High_10_21 = fmt_b(v_hi),
      Effect_Hi_vs_Lo = ifelse(is.finite(diff_pct), sprintf("%+.1f pp", diff_pct), "-"),
      p_value = ifelse(is.na(pval), "-", ifelse(pval < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pval))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
})

comp_df <- do.call(rbind, comp_rows)
names(comp_df) <- c(
  "Variable",
  sprintf("Low GAD-7 (0-4) [N=%d]", length(idx_lo)),
  sprintf("Middle (5-9) [N=%d]", length(idx_mid)),
  sprintf("High GAD-7 (10-21) [N=%d]", length(idx_hi)),
  "Diff (High - Low)",
  "p (High vs Low)"
)
save_tab(comp_df, "05_anxiety_group_comparison_table.csv")
make_tab(comp_df, caption = "Table 5. Demographic, psychological, and physiological comparison across GAD-7 groups (Wilcoxon / Chi-square tests for High vs. Low).")
```

## 5. Correlations with GAD-7, Covariate Matrix & PCA Structure

In Section 2.4.5.3 (Mediation), control variables significantly correlated with GAD-7 are candidate mediators if adding PCA-orthogonalized controls attenuates a primary HEP-anxiety effect. Below we report both **Pearson ($r$)** and **Spearman ($\rho$)** correlations with continuous GAD-7 scores, followed by the full pairwise Spearman correlation heatmap and a preview of the PCA variance structure across the participant-level controls.

```{r gad7-correlations}
cor_targets <- list(
  "Depression (IDS-SR)"      = df$IDS_num,
  "Sex (1 = Female)"         = df$is_female,
  "Age at EEG (years)"       = df$age_num,
  "Heart Rate (bpm)"         = df$hr_num,
  "HRV RMSSD (ms)"           = df$rmssd_num,
  "BMI (kg/m2)"              = df$bmi_num,
  "Systolic BP (mmHg)"       = df$sbp_num,
  "Diastolic BP (mmHg)"      = df$dbp_num,
  "Biplane Stroke Volume (mL)" = df$sv_num,
  "Diabetes ADA_DS (1=Yes)"  = df$diab_bin,
  "|EEG - GAD-7 Gap| (days)" = df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs
)

gad_cor_rows <- lapply(names(cor_targets), function(nm) {
  y <- cor_targets[[nm]]
  ok <- !is.na(df$GAD7_num) & !is.na(y)
  n_pair <- sum(ok)
  # Keep a visible "not estimable" row instead of failing on all-missing or
  # constant binary diabetes status in a sparse matched subsample.
  if (n_pair < 10 || length(unique(df$GAD7_num[ok])) < 2L ||
      length(unique(y[ok])) < 2L) {
    return(data.frame(
      Control_Variable = nm, Pairwise_N = n_pair,
      Pearson_r = "-", Pearson_p = "-", Spearman_rho = "-",
      Spearman_p = "-", Sig_p05 = "Not estimable",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  rp <- cor.test(df$GAD7_num[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")
  rs <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df$GAD7_num[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))
  data.frame(
    Control_Variable = nm,
    Pairwise_N = n_pair,
    Pearson_r = sprintf("%+.3f", rp$estimate),
    Pearson_p = ifelse(rp$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", rp$p.value)),
    Spearman_rho = sprintf("%+.3f", rs$estimate),
    Spearman_p = ifelse(rs$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", rs$p.value)),
    Sig_p05 = ifelse(rp$p.value < 0.05 | rs$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
gad_cor_df <- do.call(rbind, gad_cor_rows)
save_tab(gad_cor_df, "06_correlations_with_GAD7.csv")
make_tab(gad_cor_df, caption = "Table 6. Bivariate associations between continuous GAD-7 anxiety scores and preregistered control variables.")
```

```{r correlation-heatmap, fig.height=4.8}
mat_df <- data.frame(
  `GAD-7`     = df$GAD7_num,
  `IDS-SR`    = df$IDS_num,
  `Age`       = df$age_num,
  `Female`    = df$is_female,
  `HR`        = df$hr_num,
  `RMSSD`     = df$rmssd_num,
  `BMI`       = df$bmi_num,
  `SBP`       = df$sbp_num,
  `DBP`       = df$dbp_num,
  `BiplaneSV` = df$sv_num,
  `Diabetes`  = df$diab_bin,
  `GapDays`   = df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cmat <- cor(mat_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
save_tab(cbind(Variable = rownames(cmat), as.data.frame(round(cmat, 3))), "07_spearman_correlation_matrix.csv")

vars_ord <- colnames(cmat)
grid_cor <- expand.grid(Var1 = vars_ord, Var2 = rev(vars_ord), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grid_cor$rho <- as.vector(cmat[cbind(grid_cor$Var1, grid_cor$Var2)])
grid_cor$Var1 <- factor(grid_cor$Var1, levels = vars_ord)
grid_cor$Var2 <- factor(grid_cor$Var2, levels = rev(vars_ord))

p_cor <- ggplot(grid_cor, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise Spearman Correlation Matrix of Anxiety & Control Variables",
    subtitle = "Pairwise complete observations in post-exclusion sample",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman\nrho"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())

save_fig(p_cor, "fig03_covariate_correlation_heatmap.png", w = 6.5, h = 4.8)
print(p_cor)
```

```{r pca-preview}
pca_input <- df[, ctrl_vars_10]
pca_cc <- pca_input[complete.cases(pca_input), ]
if (nrow(pca_cc) > 30) {
  keep_v <- vapply(pca_cc, function(z) sd(z) > 0, logical(1))
  pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_cc[, keep_v], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp <- (pca_fit$sdev^2) / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2)
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    Component = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_exp)),
    Eigenvalue = round(pca_fit$sdev^2, 3),
    Variance_Pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * var_exp),
    Cumulative_Pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * cumsum(var_exp)),
    Exceeds_1Pct_Cutoff = ifelse(var_exp > 0.01, "Yes", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  save_tab(pca_df, "08_pca_controls_variance_preview.csv")
  make_tab(pca_df, caption = sprintf("Table 7. Collinearity & PCA preview across %d participant-level controls (complete N = %d; pipeline-specific alpha power added later; height excluded).", sum(keep_v), nrow(pca_cc)))
}
```

## 6. Assessment Dates, Temporal Gaps & the <30-Day Sensitivity Subsample

Because LIFE assessments occurred across separate visits (Section 2.4.6.1), we inspect calendar coverage for all recorded dates, the temporal separation between **Resting EEG (`date_eeg`)** and **GAD-7 (`date_gad7`)**, and sample sizes for the preregistered **< 30-day sensitivity subsample**.

```{r date-coverage-table}
date_labels <- c(
  date_eeg = "Resting-State EEG (date_eeg)",
  date_gad7 = "GAD-7 Questionnaire (date_gad7)",
  date_ids = "IDS-SR Depression (date_ids)",
  date_bp = "Blood Pressure Exam (date_bp)",
  date_bmi = "BMI Anthropometry (date_bmi)",
  date_ecg = "12-Lead Clinical ECG (date_ecg)",
  date_echo = "Echo Assessment (date_echo)",
  date_echo_2 = "Additional Echo Date (date_echo_2)",
  date_medications = "Medication Interview (date_medications)"
)

dt_rows <- lapply(names(date_labels), function(dc) {
  col_dt <- paste0(dc, "_dt")
  if (!col_dt %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
  d <- df[[col_dt]]
  d_ok <- d[!is.na(d)]
  if (!length(d_ok)) return(NULL)
  gap_d <- abs(as.numeric(df$date_eeg_dt - d))
  gap_ok <- gap_d[!is.na(gap_d)]
  data.frame(
    Assessment = date_labels[[dc]],
    Valid_Dates = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", length(d_ok), 100 * length(d_ok) / N),
    Earliest = as.character(min(d_ok)),
    Median_Date = as.character(median(d_ok)),
    Latest = as.character(max(d_ok)),
    Abs_Gap_to_EEG_Days_Med_IQR = if (dc == "date_eeg" || !length(gap_ok)) "-" else
      sprintf("%.0f (%.0f - %.0f)", median(gap_ok), quantile(gap_ok, 0.25), quantile(gap_ok, 0.75)),
    Within_30d_of_EEG = if (dc == "date_eeg" || !length(gap_ok)) "-" else
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(gap_ok < 30), 100 * mean(gap_ok < 30)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
dt_df <- do.call(rbind, dt_rows)
save_tab(dt_df, "09_assessment_dates_and_gaps_to_eeg.csv")
make_tab(dt_df, caption = "Table 8. Calendar range of key assessments and absolute temporal distance to the EEG recording.")
```

### Detailed Breakdown of the EEG - GAD-7 Temporal Gap

```{r gap-buckets-table}
g_signed <- df$gap_eeg_gad7_signed
g_abs    <- df$gap_eeg_gad7_abs
has_gap  <- !is.na(g_abs)

buckets <- cut(
  g_abs,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 7, 14, 29.999, 60, 90, 180, 365, Inf),
  labels = c(
    "Same day (0 days)",
    "1 - 7 days",
    "8 - 14 days",
    "15 - 29 days",
    "30 - 60 days",
    "61 - 90 days",
    "91 - 180 days",
    "181 - 365 days",
    "> 365 days"
  )
)

b_tab <- lapply(levels(buckets), function(lvl) {
  ix <- which(buckets == lvl)
  data.frame(
    Gap_Window = lvl,
    Total_N = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", length(ix), 100 * length(ix) / sum(has_gap)),
    Low_GAD7_0_4 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix] == "Low (0-4)", na.rm = TRUE),
    Mid_GAD7_5_9 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix] == "Mild/Middle (5-9)", na.rm = TRUE),
    High_GAD7_10_21 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix] == "High (10-21)", na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
b_df <- do.call(rbind, b_tab)

ix_u30 <- which(df$under_30d)
u30_row <- data.frame(
  Gap_Window = "PREREGISTERED SUBSAMPLE: < 30 days (0 - 29 d)",
  Total_N = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", length(ix_u30), 100 * length(ix_u30) / sum(has_gap)),
  Low_GAD7_0_4 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix_u30] == "Low (0-4)", na.rm = TRUE),
  Mid_GAD7_5_9 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix_u30] == "Mild/Middle (5-9)", na.rm = TRUE),
  High_GAD7_10_21 = sum(df$anx_stratum[ix_u30] == "High (10-21)", na.rm = TRUE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
b_df <- rbind(b_df, u30_row)

save_tab(b_df, "10_eeg_gad7_gap_windows_by_anxiety.csv")
make_tab(b_df, caption = "Table 9. Participant counts by |EEG - GAD-7| recording gap and anxiety group (H1b/d sensitivity rerun requires High GAD-7 N >= 25 in <30d subsample).")
```

*Order of assessments:* Among `r sum(has_gap)` participants with both dates available, EEG occurred **after** GAD-7 (`date_eeg > date_gad7`) in **`r sum(g_signed > 0, na.rm = TRUE)` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(g_signed > 0, na.rm = TRUE))`)**, on the **same day** in **`r sum(g_signed == 0, na.rm = TRUE)` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(g_signed == 0, na.rm = TRUE))`)**, and **before** GAD-7 (`date_eeg < date_gad7`) in **`r sum(g_signed < 0, na.rm = TRUE)` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(g_signed < 0, na.rm = TRUE))`)** participants (signed median = `r sprintf("%+.0f", median(g_signed, na.rm = TRUE))` days; signed mean = `r sprintf("%+.1f", mean(g_signed, na.rm = TRUE))` days, SD = `r sprintf("%.1f", sd(g_signed, na.rm = TRUE))` days).
